# #287 — deploy: core01-deploy-local.sh targets system/com.rico.open-brain but service is a gui/rico LaunchAgent

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: bug
Created: 2026-07-08T17:08:09Z
Updated: 2026-07-20T21:50:34Z
Closed: 2026-07-20T21:50:34Z

---

The tag-triggered CI deploy job runs `scripts/core01-deploy-local.sh`, which does `sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.rico.open-brain`. No such **system**-domain service exists — the HTTP service now runs as a **rico LaunchAgent** in `gui/$(id -u)/com.rico.open-brain` (installed this deploy, RunAtLoad + KeepAlive, boot-persistent, paths under /Users/rico because launchd's gui domain can't set WorkingDirectory/logs on the /Volumes external volume — that was the EX_CONFIG cause).

**Impact:** every future `v*` tag deploy will succeed at code-swap + migrations, then FAIL at the service restart (exit 113, 'Could not find service ... in domain for system'), leaving new code staged but the old process running.

**Fix:** update the deploy script's `SERVICE_LABEL` to `gui/<uid>/com.rico.open-brain` and use `launchctl kickstart -k` in the gui domain (no sudo). Same applies to the new `com.rico.open-brain-nats-worker`. Also: the CI `deploy` job's restart step has never actually restarted the service — worth verifying the whole job end-to-end.

Discovered during the NATS fleet-bus deploy (v0.1.0-rc.3).

## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-07-20T06:55:26Z

### Confirmed against current `main` (`bb52373`)

`scripts/core01-deploy-local.sh`:
- L7: `SERVICE_LABEL="${SERVICE_LABEL:-system/com.rico.open-brain}"` — defaults to the **system** domain.
- L155 and L166: `sudo launchctl kickstart -k "$SERVICE_LABEL"` (deploy restart + rollback restart).

Both restart points target `system/…`, so the reported failure mode stands: a `v*` tag deploy swaps code + runs migrations, then the `kickstart` (and the rollback `kickstart`) fail with "Could not find service … in domain for system" against a `gui/<uid>` LaunchAgent, leaving new code staged but the old process live — and the **rollback path hits the same wall**, so a failed deploy can't self-restore either.

**Additional confirmation:** the `-nats-worker` service is **not restarted anywhere in this script** (`grep` for `nats-worker` in the file: no matches). So even after fixing the label, the NATS worker won't be kicked on deploy.

**Fix (unchanged from report, scoped):**
1. `SERVICE_LABEL` default → `gui/$(id -u)/com.rico.open-brain`; drop `sudo` for the gui-domain kickstart.
2. Add a parallel restart for `gui/$(id -u)/com.rico.open-brain-nats-worker`.
3. End-to-end verify the CI `deploy` job's restart step actually restarts (the report notes it may never have).

Still a real deploy-path bug; nothing on main has addressed it.
